Near-term structure: a confirmed double-bottom (lows $61,537 July 8 / $61,697 July 9, neckline $63,499 broken July 10) with five consecutive Gate 2 midnight holds building a higher-low floor on the daily timeframe. Today's session created a new lower intraday low ($63,631 vs $63,892 yesterday), but the five-session midnight close series remains above $62,000.
